'''Rychel''' was a remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Rychel system/Legends|Rychel system]] of the [[Dalonbian sector/Legends|Dalonbian sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Rychel was [[Evacuation of Rychel|invaded]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] early in the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], shortly after the [[Battle of Artorias]]. Members of the [[New Jedi Order]], including [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Lar Le'Ung|Le'Ung]], and new recruit [[Finn Galfridian]] helped evacuate the planet, at the cost of Le'Ung's life and many troops and civilians.

==History==
===Invasion on Rychel===
{{Quote|The Yuuzhan Vong have launched an attack against the planet Rychel. The Jedi have been asked to aid in the evacuation.|Unidentified Jedi to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Invasion 2">[[Invasion 2|''Invasion'' 2]]</ref>}}
[[File:Worm_creature.jpg|left|thumb|250px|The chaos of battle]]
Starting in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], a full-scale [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] by the extragalactic race of conquerors known as the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] began. As their beachhead, they chose the remote [[Dalonbian sector/Legends|Dalonbian sector]], where they began systematically seizing sparsely populated and seemingly worthless worlds. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] largely ignored the unfolding events, dismissing the unrest along the border as mere «regional issues». However, when pleas for help came from the population of Rychel, the Republic government finally made the effort to organize a modest evacuation mission, even calling upon the [[New Jedi Order]], who were tasked with leading the effort. The [[Evacuation of Rychel|operation]] was placed under the command of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Lar Le'Ung|Lar Le'Ung]], who also decided that Rychel would be a suitable place to take the new recruit [[Finn Galfridian]] for his first real trial.<ref name="Invasion 2" />

Upon reaching Rychel's orbit, the [[Bulwark Mark III|Republic vessels]] landed at the site of the Yuuzhan Vong incursion. Le’ung and Galfridian took command of the [[New Republic soldier|ground troops]], who were tasked with distracting two massive Yuuzhan Vong beasts – [[Tu-Scart]] and [[Sgauru]] – while Skywalker freed the captured civilians and helped them reach the evacuation point. Amid the ongoing slaughter, the young Galfridian was given the chance to finish off the fallen Yuuzhan Vong [[Commander/Legends|commander]], [[Tsalok]], but chose mercy over rage. Finn later reunited with Master Skywalker, and together they departed Rychel aboard the last evacuation ship. A large number of civilians remained on the planet – some of whom the invaders deemed too weak or too old and were quickly executed,<ref name="Invasion 3" /> while others were enslaved.<ref name="Invasion 4" />

===Yuuzhan Vong's power over planet===
[[File:VongformingRychel.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Rychel in process [[Terraforming/Legends|Vongformation]]]]
The conquered planet was handed over to Tsalok by the Yuuzhan Vong, placing it under his personal control – though in truth, he was far from pleased with the new assignment.<ref name="Invasion 4" /> Before long, Tsalok left Rychel and traveled to the [[Shaper research facility]] on [[Dibrook]].<ref name="Invasion 7">[[Invasion: Rescues 2|''Invasion: Rescues'' 2]]</ref> The Yuuzhan Vong commander’s arrival coincided with a sudden Republic [[Rescue Mission to Dibrook|assault]] on the facility, putting scientists, valuable research, and an important biotechnological war coordinator, [[Yammosk|the yammosk]], at risk. Realizing that the site could not be held, Tsalok ordered the immediate extraction of the yammosk from beneath Dibrook and had the entire Shaper base relocated to Rychel, where it would remain under his supervision.<ref name="Invasion 8">[[Invasion: Rescues 3|''Invasion: Rescues'' 3]]</ref>

Over the following two months, the Shaper headquarters on Rychel worked diligently to develop a weapon capable of wiping out the entire Jedi Order.<ref name="Invasion 12">[[Invasion: Revelations 1|''Invasion: Revelations'' 1]]</ref> And while Tsalok was engaged in the [[Battle of Shramar]], the long-awaited weapon was finally completed.<ref name="Invasion 16">[[Invasion: Revelations 5|''Invasion: Revelations'' 5]]</ref>
